messages:
Tim: Heads up — main CI turned red right after the merge that landed a tools container bump (Lina's PR). Smoke stage failed on the runtime image. CI: <https://ci.redwood.local/runs/5543216701|5543216701>
ci-bot: Pipeline 5543216701 failed at stage `smoke-tests` (step: smoke-gpu) — failing test: `tests/integration/test_shard_alloc.py::test_kv_alloc_worker`. Logs: <https://ci.redwood.local/logs/5543216701|log>
Priya: :eyes: Is this coming from the tools image change or did the merge touch runtime bits? can someone who merged take a look?
Marcus: I merged (small helper + docs), didn't touch runtime. I'll kick a rerun now.
Lina: I bumped the build-tools container tag (tools:2.4.1 -> tools:2.4.2) in the PR — only that and docs. Could be unrelated but tagging infra.
Tim: Marcus please rerun. If it repros we should bisect or revert quickly. @oncall-bot can you page infra oncall?
Marcus: /rerun 5543216701 — rerun queued by Marcus.
ci-bot: Rerun queued by Marcus. New run started: 5543216733.
ci-bot: Run 5543216733 failed at `smoke-gpu` with same assertion. Failing excerpt:
```
AssertionError: Expected allocation 4096, got None
  File /workspace/tests/integration/test_shard_alloc.py:78 in test_kv_alloc_worker
  ...allocator init failed: kv_cache not found...
```
Lina: That stack looks like allocator initialization — the tools bump could have pulled a different runtime flag or kernel lib. Tools tag used: `tools:2.4.2` -> digest `sha256:abc123`.
Priya: If allocator init is failing, maybe a kernel/userland ABI mismatch on the runner image. @oncall-bot please escalate to eng-infra oncall and ops.
oncall-bot: Paging eng-infra oncall: HIGH - main CI smoke failing on allocator init (run 5543216733). Link: <https://ci.redwood.local/runs/5543216733|run>
Marcus: Collecting runner info now: `uname -a` and `docker images`.
Marcus: Runner info:
```
Runner: ubuntu-22.04 5.15.0-101-generic
docker image redwood/runtime:latest -> digest sha256:def456
tools:2.4.2 digest sha256:abc123
```
Marcus: Uploaded full env + repro steps to gist: <https://gist.github.com/marcus/66e7|gist>
Priya: Thanks. Lina — can you open a quick revert for the tools bump? If revert makes CI green we merge it and continue investigating the tools image.
Lina: I can open a revert PR in ~10m. But infra might prefer to pin the runner image instead while we debug.
Tim: Plan: 1) Lina opens revert PR, 2) Marcus will try a local smoke with the older tools image and rerun CI, 3) Priya opens infra ticket to investigate tools:2.4.2. Owners: Lina (revert), Marcus (reruns/repro), Priya (infra ticket).
Marcus: Quick local check: repro fails on tools:2.4.2 but passes when I roll runner to tools:2.4.1. Reproducer steps in gist above.
ci-bot: Started run 5543216799 (manual run with older image). Smoke stage succeeded.
Priya: Nice. Lina please open the revert PR and mark it urgent, cc eng-infra + infra-oncall. Marcus keep monitoring main for the next hour.
Lina: Revert PR opened: <https://git.redwood.local/p/revert-tools-bump/5588|revert: bump tools->2.4.1>. CC: @eng-infra @Priya.
Tim: :thumbsup: Good response. Follow-ups: eng-infra to root-cause why tools:2.4.2 breaks allocator init; eng-ml to confirm kernel ABI implications; add smoke test pinning or digest gating for tools image. We'll watch the pipeline and update this thread.
